beats.prompt: Examine the loose ring at the west post
beats.result: The third ring has worked out of its wire. Two notes still carry. The empty horse lines belong to a larger company than the one here today.

beats.prompt: Check the west line after the confrontation
beats.result: Three posts, three sets of mismatched equipment. A camp large enough for a company held only three dead guards.

evidence.title: The three posts
evidence.text: All three stations can be accounted for. The present tolls do not establish who wrote the old sanctuary command.

beats.prompt: Check the four confiscated sacks
beats.result: Seed barley, kept to plant in spring. Feeding it to the camp would spend next year’s crop.

beats.prompt: List the two axes, three bracelets and the small shoe
beats.result: Someone can claim a tool without signing someone else’s testimony.

beats.prompt: Bring the barley to the outward carts
beats.result: The goods can go home whatever happens to the captain.

beats.prompt: Compare the voluntary account with the seizure list
beats.result: The inventory is signed in a different place. Guard watches and food are owed even if Senn stops speaking.

beats.prompt: Keep what Senn actually saw
beats.line: He was twenty-two. The northern track was closed against people trying to leave. Edric was a child. There is still a paragraph about the rain.

choices.label: Retain the weather and mark what he witnessed
choices.result: The witness keeps the rain. The copy separates observation from hearsay.

choices.label: Seal the account against public reading
choices.result: The signed source stays in custody; the barley can still be returned.

beats.prompt: Read both sides of the inspection warrant
beats.result: Merrow’s signature holds the loads. The added directions let people pass after inspection. A spoken order has left out that line.

beats.prompt: Get the trapped patrolman’s sleeve out from under the wheel
beats.result: Another man takes the hauling line. The shaft strikes Rook under the ribs as the cart goes over.

beats.prompt: Carry Elna’s coat-litter up past the fork
beats.result: The meal runs down the bank. The people reach high ground. Elna says Rook owes her a lining; this time he saves his breath.

beats.prompt: Set the litter down by the washroom
beats.result: Give Rook a small breath before moving him again. Nera keeps the route book. He still gets a bed and hot food.

beats.prompt: Ask who will stay with Pell while he petitions
beats.line: Pell’s my daughter. Those are three seasonal hands from the gardens. I can go once we agree who’s here until I’m back.
beats.result: You wait for a real handover before carrying the petition.
beats.speaker: Toma

choices.label: Carry his petition while he stays with Pell
choices.result: Toma stays home. He will entrust his written account to you.

choices.label: Ask Elna whether she can keep the afternoon watch
choices.result: You still need her answer. Toma stays with his daughter until someone actually takes the watch.

beats.speaker: Toma
beats.prompt: Collect the signed sheet for the gate
beats.line: Three marks, and my name under them. I can stay here with her if you can find the right door.
beats.result: The signed petition goes to the gate with Kael.

variants.speaker: Elna
variants.prompt: Ask if she wants the afternoon watch
variants.line: This afternoon. The evening is mine. Tell him if the queue goes past the bell he sends you straight back.

choices.label: Accept only the shift she offers
choices.result: Pell is in Elna’s care for the agreed afternoon.

choices.label: Carry the petition and keep Toma home
choices.result: Elna keeps her afternoon. Toma stays with Pell.

beats.prompt: Present the three workers’ marks at the lower gate
beats.result: Two charges appear twice. One tool bond had already expired.

beats.prompt: Collect the workers’ stamped receipt after the garden handover
beats.result: Their tools have already been released. Toma’s receipt protects the workers if a clerk tries to charge them again.

beats.prompt: Trace the date and seal on the old closure order
beats.result: The office seal acknowledges a closure thirty-two years ago. Edric was a child then.

beats.prompt: Compare the flattened stock beside the warrant tray
beats.result: The tray contains flattened wire worked the same way. This links the stock to an office, not a command to attack.

evidence.title: Stock at the warrant tray
evidence.text: The flattened sections match the wire from Wychwood. Material and authority are different pieces of evidence.

beats.prompt: Compare the instruction in red office thread
beats.result: Six years ago, Edric was grown. His own instruction kept the older file out of reach.

evidence.title: The dated instruction
evidence.text: The old closure and Edric’s suppression instruction are distinct documents, separated by twenty-six years.

beats.prompt: Check both copies and receipt the sealed original
beats.result: Page by page, in front of two clerks. The custody receipt and the suppression instruction travel separately.

scenes.title: A ration for an absent daughter

beats.prompt: Weigh a real ration at the court store
beats.result: The flour is real. So is the old woman waiting beside it.

beats.prompt: Compare the ration slip to the assent line
beats.line: The signature claims assent for present and absent household members. A hand raw from work rests beside the pen.

choices.label: Pay this ration without collecting a signature
choices.result: One woman can take her flour. The condition still faces the next household.

choices.label: Make a witnessed copy of the condition
choices.result: You preserve the wording for the Assembly. A copy will not feed the queue.

beats.prompt: Slip felt beneath the rattling iron
beats.result: The bracket grows quiet. Behind the drip from the channel, a second rhythm returns.

beats.prompt: Lay out the sanctuary order and put the newer sleeve aside
beats.result: The living lord’s instruction was written after Halvern died. Only the old gate belongs in this hearing.

beats.prompt: Wrap the account after Halvern’s resolution
beats.result: The old promise, the closure, the refusal. The copy has room to mark where this witness ends.

evidence.title: Where the gate account ends
evidence.text: The undercroft belongs to Halvern’s last escort. He supplies no evidence about Edric’s later suppression or Kael’s own retreat.

scenes.title: Two stools and a flat stone

beats.prompt: Set two stools apart with a writing board between them
beats.result: The road is visible from both seats. Nera can leave from hers.

beats.prompt: Reconstruct the words of Kael’s old report
beats.line: “We withdrew under orders.” You remember writing it. Vale does not have the old report on her board. What happened after the retreat?

choices.label: Add the decision to stay away under Kael’s name
choices.result: “I chose not to come back.” Vale labels it as remembered wording, followed by a correction.

choices.label: Seal the exact correction for the relief crew
choices.result: His signature and the decision not to return stay with the crew’s private account.

choices.label: Decline to give a correction now
choices.result: Vale lifts her pen. Nera keeps the right to speak about the night as she lived it.

beats.prompt: Dry the two accounts separately
beats.result: Nera’s record belongs to Nera. Kael’s name and choice stay on his page. Nothing here asks her to forgive him.

variants.result: Kael has given no correction. Nera owes him neither her story nor a reply.

beats.prompt: Find the rotten rungs before lifting the roof ladder
beats.result: Two give way. There is one length of patched sailcloth for a leaking room or for privacy.

beats.prompt: Carry the patch to the first-night shelter
beats.line: The cloth can do one job tonight. Both beds and records still need actual dry places.

choices.label: Cover the leaking roof; use a borrowed screen below
choices.result: Rain runs outside. The second bed waits behind the borrowed screen.

choices.label: Divide the sleeping room; keep records in the dry washroom
choices.result: Someone can change behind the cloth. Papers go uphill in a closed chest.

beats.prompt: Draw the first bucket and clear the smoky flue
beats.result: A leaf floats in the first bucket. The second comes up clean. There is one night of shelter here, and still a house to build.

beats.prompt: Offer to return her folded scrap
beats.line: I took my ring off before I went to see him. Spent the whole road choosing which hand I’d slap him with. He offered to stand! Imagine walking that far for a man to offer to help.
beats.result: Mira’s laugh lasts half a breath. Elna puts the ring on herself. Her private letter stays folded.
beats.speaker: Elna

beats.prompt: Offer to mend the snag in her cuff
beats.line: I need a stool, a witness, and one person willing to pull this splinter. There isn’t a form. I did look.
beats.result: She rolls her cuff back. It is the first time you have seen her lend anyone the tweezers.
beats.speaker: Vale

choices.label: Hold the light while she takes it out
choices.result: Vale gets it on the second try.

choices.label: Use the tweezers only when she says to
choices.result: “Now,” she says, and the splinter lifts clear.

beats.prompt: Compare the office signature with the culvert warrant
beats.line: I authorized inspection. I left that space blank. Those are both things I did. Don’t copy the blank out of it.
beats.result: A copy can show what Merrow ordered without excusing what he left to others.
beats.speaker: Merrow

evidence.title: Merrow’s office copy
evidence.text: Merrow authorized the load inspection. The culvert instructions were added in a different hand.

beats.prompt: Listen without putting your correction in her account
beats.line: He put crumbs in my blanket. Said I’d always know where to find breakfast. I put a beetle in his boot. My mother lived another two days. I decide which part of that goes on a page.
beats.result: Her hand stays on the paper.
beats.speaker: Nera

choices.label: Return both stools without making a copy
choices.result: The exact words remain private.

choices.label: Ask whether she wants any of it kept
choices.result: She releases the dates alone. She takes the page with Jem’s story back.

beats.prompt: Set dry linen by the washroom stove
beats.result: The person on the litter goes in first. A woman asks about her mother. The bench fits two.

beats.prompt: Ask what the office actually authorized
beats.line: I told Rook there might be a delay. I knew there could be a seizure. He gave me no homes.
beats.result: The counterpart gives a time and a place. The space for expected persons is blank.
beats.speaker: Merrow
beats.reply: Keep the office copy and leave the sickroom quiet

evidence.title: Counterpart of the inspection warrant
evidence.text: Merrow authorized holding grain and records. This copy names no households and does not direct the patrol to the weak bank.

beats.prompt: Wedge the cupboard while Toma empties the ash shelves
beats.result: The wood gives at the joint. Toma slips the wedge closer and the shelves stay in one piece.

beats.prompt: Pull the rag and plaster out of the north drain
beats.result: Water moves into the yard. A pale Inkblind leaves the wet paste for the shadow beneath the cupboard.

beats.prompt: Return Vale’s second pen
beats.line: You can keep the first when you find it. The last man put a wet book in a fire. I’ll take a missing pen.
beats.result: She seats the copy stool on the dry patch. The household packet stays in its owner’s hands.
beats.speaker: Vale
beats.reply: Set out the stool and leave her the lamp

beats.prompt: Ask why the ordinary grain book has no refusal column
beats.line: Because the answer is in another book. The seal key goes back tonight. Come while I can open it.
beats.result: Merrow agrees to show the duplicate. He has made no promise to surrender it.
beats.speaker: Merrow

beats.prompt: Look below the coin tray at the kitchen count
beats.line: An absent spouse. No undertaking. Beside them, zero and half. Merrow keeps his hand on the lid.
beats.result: The two keys turn again. The duplicate remains under the bench.

choices.label: Ask for the ledger
choices.result: Merrow closes the lid. “Who takes the desk tomorrow?” He will not give it up today.

choices.label: Remember the column without copying the names
choices.result: Kael steps away. From the cold hearth he hears both locks turn.

evidence.title: The weekly refusal column
evidence.text: Kael saw the steward’s duplicate at the weekly count. The book is still in the kitchen. No household names were copied.

beats.prompt: Carry a clean basin to the woman beside the kitchen
beats.result: She tries to apologize for the rug. Edric says it was ugly already and waits until she can laugh without coughing.

beats.prompt: Bring broth and check the number on her ration slip
beats.result: One transposed number. It is put right before she goes. At the next hatch another clerk still has orders to give half.

beats.prompt: Sketch the rim and the bracket where the helm lay
beats.result: The little star has five very unequal arms. Record the marks before moving anything.

evidence.title: Star cut into the rim
evidence.text: A child-sized scratch on the dented helmet. Neither the star nor the broken buckle gives the child’s name.

beats.prompt: Wedge the sanctuary door open as you leave
beats.result: The felt keeps the lamp quiet. Kael leaves the newer suppression paper folded in its own wrapper.

scenes.title: Two children under the flour sheet

beats.prompt: Let Nera count the old escort
beats.line: Twenty-seven on your list. Twenty-nine on the road. The two under the flour sheet brought us water. You don’t go looking for them to finish something.
beats.result: Nera puts her finger on the space for affiliation. “Write unknown.”
beats.speaker: Nera

choices.label: Offer a closed sleeve for her own account
choices.result: Jem died on the fourth morning. Leth lived two more days. Nera authorizes only the closed copy. Kael may speak for himself.

choices.label: Put the pen down and listen
choices.result: Nera carries her own stool back to the cart. Kael has heard her. The page stays blank.

beats.prompt: Walk a little way from the hearth with Mira
beats.line: Nera told me the part she wanted me to know. You let me think you’d tried afterwards. I thought you had.
beats.result: Mira lets Kael stand with the discomfort. Rook still needs somebody to help with the slate.
beats.speaker: Mira

choices.label: Hear her out and give her the morning
choices.result: She pulls a leaf apart and throws it into the water. “Go and be useful without making it a penance.”

choices.label: Tell her you love her, then let her go to work
choices.result: “I love you,” she says crossly. “That hasn’t made me less angry.” She goes back on her own.

beats.prompt: Set Rook’s slate on the rolled blanket
beats.result: The open sack was counted once by weight and once by meals. Both figures are right. Rook finds this especially annoying.

scenes.title: A place that already has a tenant

beats.prompt: Lift the damp wool clear of the warming box
beats.result: A little Hearthscale opens one eye. Elna shifts the bed the other way. ‘First tenant.’ The creature keeps the corner.

beats.prompt: Separate Toma’s washing pail from the water for boiling
beats.result: Pell says boiled water tastes of spoons. Toma has never worked out what that means. He keeps the second draw for the stove.

beats.prompt: Pass up the stave for the chimney ladder
beats.result: The nest was only half the trouble. A loose stone drops onto the hearth. Rook coughs that the smoke at least was free.

beats.prompt: Set out the bowls once the second fire draws
beats.result: The key lies beside the guard’s bowl. The stew goes through the doorway whether or not the occupant can testify. Nobody calls that an acquittal.

variants.result: Merrow starts to apologize about the state of the house. Elna puts a bowl into his hands before he can make it formal.

beats.prompt: Read the inspection letter at the head of the causeway
beats.result: Merrow says no person will be held. The road is one cart wide. A driver cannot leave disputed goods without leaving the cart.

beats.prompt: Pass the copy to the rear before unloading
beats.result: The rear knows whom to ask for a receipt when a load is held. Rook’s exposure of the route is already on the crew’s account.

scenes.title: A door that can be watched

beats.prompt: Test the latch from the watch side
beats.result: The room is dry. A guard can see its only door from a chair. The hearing and the business of feeding the man are separate decisions.

beats.prompt: Carry an ordinary portion to the guarded room
beats.result: The guard takes the bowl. No family is asked to visit or listen. Someone still has to wash it before breakfast.
